messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer reported client SDK estimator is ~30% lower than invoice for a streaming chat flow. invoice shows 168 tokens, client estimate shows 124. Can we triage?
ben_engineering: Can you paste the minimal repro (curl or SDK) and which model + streaming vs non-streaming?
maria_support: Repro (redacted):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the doc."}],"stream":true}'
```
joe_billing: Customer saw this on 2026-01-29 17:02 UTC, invoice spike coincided with a support ticket. They attached their client-side debug logs showing estimator output.
kevin_sre: Quick Q: does the estimator account for server-injected system/tool messages (we sometimes inject logging/system markers for private deployments)?
maria_support: Client estimator log: `est_total=124 tokens (prompt: 86, completion: 38)`
maria_support: Server metering row: `metered_total=168 tokens (prompt+system+tool+completion)`
ben_engineering: Hm. There are two usual suspects: 1) hidden assistant/system messages inserted by sidecar (e.g., function call scaffolding or debug markers) 2) streaming cutoff heuristics in the client estimator that exclude trailing EOF tokens.
ben_engineering: Can you attach the raw request/response (with headers) and a server metering dump id?
maria_support: Attached: metering_id=met-20260129-51bd, logs (redacted). Also flagged that the customer called our python SDK v0.8.3.
kevin_sre: Looking at met-20260129-51bd: there are 3 additional server-inserted messages: `system: <tracehook start>`, `assistant: <tool:pdf-extract()>`, `assistant: <tool:pdf-extract()>` (tool name and JSON payload). Those tool-call tokens are counted server-side.
maria_support: Customer said their estimator does not include tool call scaffolding because the SDK token estimator ignores assistant messages injected after the initial user chunk when streaming.
ben_engineering: That matches a known edge case: our client-side estimator used in v0.8.3 only tokenizes the explicit messages passed client->API. It doesn't re-tokenize server-streamed assistant messages or function call deltas because that would require replaying the stream. So it undercounts when server inserts assistant messages (tool calls / system traces).
kevin_sre: Repro steps for engineering: 1) run streaming request that triggers a function/tool. 2) capture the server stream including `event: delta` messages that contain partial assistant content and `<tool>` markers. 3) compare token counts: run our server metering export.
ben_engineering: Minimal repro (I ran locally):
```
# start stream, emulate tool call
python -c "from redwood import Client; c=Client();
 r=c.chat.create(model='redwood-large-v1', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'Extract section headings from the attached PDF'}], stream=True)
 for chunk in r: print(chunk)"
```
metering-bot: Metering export: met-20260129-51bd -> prompt:90, system+tool:38, completion:40, total:168
joe_billing: So customer sees 124 because their estimator missed the 38 tokens from system+tool. Need to communicate root cause and mitigation.
maria_support: Customer is worried about unexpected charges. Any immediate mitigation to recommend?
ben_engineering: Short-term: recommend they disable client-side estimator for billing reconciliation and use server tokenization endpoint /metering/estimate with the exact request payload (server will include injected messages), or upgrade SDK to v0.9.x (we've patched estimator to optionally re-tokenize streamed assistant deltas).
ben_engineering: Patch notes: v0.9.0 adds `Client.tokenize_with_server_side_inserts(messages, include_streamed_assistant=True)` which simulates server inserts for common tool scaffolding and counts those tokens.
kevin_sre: Longer-term: we will add a metering preview endpoint that accepts a request and returns the tokenized sequence we will charge, including sidecar inserts (RFC in eng backlog).
maria_support: Communicated to customer: explain discrepancy, offered 1) invoice credit review if still anomalous, 2) recommend using server estimation endpoint or SDK upgrade, 3) how to reproduce locally to confirm. Customer requested credit review.
joe_billing: Filed billing ticket BILL-4521 to review met-20260129-51bd and customer invoice.
ben_engineering: Root cause summary (for notes): client estimator undercounted because it only tokenizes client-sent messages and does not account for server-inserted assistant messages and tool-call scaffolding which are metered. Streaming semantics (partial deltas) made it harder for the estimator to reconstruct the final assistant message.
maria_support: Thanks all. Marking as customer-facing doc for the KB: "Why my client estimator is lower than the invoice (streaming + tool calls)" :eyes: :thumbsup:
kevin_sre: FYI I'll add a short repro gist and link to BILL-4521 in the ticket.
ben_engineering: Also note: if customers use our hosted API with functions/tooling enabled, server may add `assistant` messages and tool invocations at charging time. Recommend adding note to docs and sample code to use server-side estimator for accurate billing reconciliation.
maria_support: Closing thread for now — follow-ups in BILL-4521 and ENG-REPRO-231.
